text:
QUOTE: "Without it, `sanitizeReactions` computes `deleteReactions` as every local reaction on the post that is absent from the payload. The payload holds only one reaction, so a single event would delete all the other reactions on that post."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that the single incoming reaction would be treated as the full set, and that without `skipSync` every other reaction on the post would be deleted.
